comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus pour a measured syrup dose into a cup.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled feed plus bimanual screen agitation and bridge clearing versus coordinated liquid pouring into a held level cup.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% target-media recovery with complete washer retention and zero loss, versus 9–11 mL dose, low spill and both vessels replaced.
comparison.reason: Controlled pouring is shared, but the candidate's defining tested ability is size-selective granular separation, not liquid metering.
